title: Fix non-functional notifications bell placeholder in topbar
goal: Remove the notifications bell from the topbar entirely. This is the safest fix - a broken bell is worse than no bell. If a notification panel is desired instead, it must: open on click, close on Escape or second click, show last 5 audit events from the existing dashboard API response, and require no new backend endpoints. Removing is strongly preferred for this task.
scope: Walkthrough 2026-04-30: The topbar contains a bell button. Clicking it produces no visible response - no panel, dropdown, modal, or tooltip appears. No notification center exists in the DOM. This is a non-functional placeholder that creates operator confusion about whether they have missed critical alerts.
